title: Sunken Solarium - Remembered Summer
_note: Option A anchor. gbc 4-voice band. emotional preset. Nostalgic G major with one wistful borrowed minor turn (E minor / C minor color). 96 BPM, 4/4, 24 bars (~30s). Vesper motif stated warmly and fully in major as the lead's opening: rising leap D4->G4->A4 (radiant overshoot) then tender settle B4->A4->G4. Lead phrases rise then sigh down a step. pulse12 soft harp-like rolling broken-triad arpeggio (Solar signature). tri_bass slow warm root-fifth. drums soft brushed kick on 1 & 3, faint hat — light lapping on water. Last bar (D7 chord implied via arp + bass D->G pickup) voice-leads to bar 1.
